hooks.name: Validate Rule Schema
hooks.description: When a predefined rule file (data/rules/*.json) is created or modified, validate it against the RuleCreate schema

action.prompt: A predefined rule file in data/rules/ was saved. Validate it against the RuleCreate schema in backend/schemas/rule.py and the declarative rule format of AGENTS.md §20 (trigger, joins, window_seconds, emit; allowed operators: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, contains, in). The file also needs a `status` (active or inactive), no unknown key, and an `id` equal to the file name. To check it, run from backend/: python -m engine.validate_rules (validates every file of <DATA_DIR>/rules, or pass a directory). Fix any error reported.
